loopSettings.description:
Loop's therapy-settings block, written into the profile document
alongside `store`.

This is the **attribute-flattening** camp described in
`docs/sdqctl-proposals/x-aid-extensions-convention-proposal.md`,
measured: a 26-path subtree that 10 of 11 sites in the 2026-04 corpus
write into 99% of their profile documents, and that no spec in this
repo described before this revision.

Documented here because it exists and consumers must read it, not as
an endorsement of flattening vendor settings into the shared document
shape.

units.description:
Per-profile glucose display units, distinct from the document's
top-level `units`.

Present in **100% of profile documents on all 11 sites** and
entirely undeclared before this revision — the highest-confidence
omission the census found in this collection.
notes: declared enum not enforced: 2 of 3 observed values could not be published, so the enum cannot be shown to be complete

units.sensitivity_why: values survived cross-site corroboration, so they are shared vocabulary
units.description:
Glucose display units.

Enum widened to cover live data. Three specs in this repo declared
three different vocabularies (`[mg, mmol]` in entries, `[mg/dl,
mmol]` here) and the corpus contains `mg/dL`, `mg/dl` and
`mmol/L` — none matching any declaration. Settling on one
vocabulary is an ecosystem question; until then a reader must
accept all of these.
notes: declared enum not enforced: 2 of 3 observed values could not be published, so the enum cannot be shown to be complete
universal in this corpus but not declared required; a write requirement is not asserted from a Loop-dominant corpus
